setup.title: Set up your library
setup.rail_note: Nothing is saved until you finish. You can change all of this later under Administration.
setup.noscript: The setup wizard needs JavaScript. Turn it on, or create an administrator with `librowise create-admin`.

welcome.title: Let's get your library ready
welcome.lead_bootstrap: This server has no administrator yet. In a few short steps you will name your library, create your administrator account and choose how lending works.
welcome.lead_admin: Your administrator account is ready. A few short steps will finish setting up the library itself.
welcome.item_library: Name your library and say what kind it is
welcome.item_lending: Choose loan periods, renewals and fines
welcome.item_start: Start with an empty catalogue, sample books or your Koha records
welcome.code_hint: To make sure you run this server, enter the 8-character code from the server log.
welcome.code_where: Where do I find the setup code?
welcome.code_where_log: It is printed in the server log when Librowise starts. You can also show it on the server with:

library.title: About your library
library.lead: Your library's name appears in the catalogue, on notices, receipts and library cards.
library.name: Library name
library.name_hint: For example "Riverside Library" or "St. Mary's College Library".
library.kind: What kind of library is it?
library.kind_hint: This picks sensible lending rules, item types and borrower categories. You can change everything later.

kind.public_desc: Adults and children, books, DVDs, magazines and audiobooks.
kind.academic_desc: Students and faculty, longer loans, reference books and theses.
kind.school_desc: Pupils and teachers, short loans, no fines.
kind.special_desc: A company, institute or society: members, reports and reference.

admin.title: Your administrator account
admin.lead: This account can change every setting and create accounts for your staff.
admin.username_hint: Used to sign in, together with your e-mail address.
admin.email_hint: For password resets and security alerts.
admin.note_2fa: After setup, turn on two-step verification for this account under My account & security.

branches.title: Where are your books?
branches.lead: Add each building or service point that lends items. A single library needs just one branch.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.code_hint: Capital letters and digits, e.g. MAIN. Used on labels and in reports.
branches.later: Opening hours and holidays are set later in the library calendar.

lending.title: How lending works
lending.lead: These are suggested rules for your kind of library ({kind}). Adjust them to match yours.
lending.hold_pickup_days: Holds wait on the shelf for

sentence_loan.one: Borrowers can take home {items} item for {days} days.
sentence_loan.other: Borrowers can take home up to {items} items for {days} days.

sentence_renew.one: Each loan can be renewed once.
sentence_renew.other: Each loan can be renewed {n} times.

lending.sentence_fine: Late items cost {fine} a day, up to {cap} per item.
lending.also_lead: So you can start lending straight away, setup adds:
lending.later: Fine-tune rules per branch, category or item type later in Administration → Circulation rules.

start.title: How would you like to start?
start.lead: You can add records by hand, by ISBN lookup or by importing MARC files at any time.
start.empty_desc: Add your own records from the staff client: by ISBN, from another library (Z39.50/SRU) or by hand.
start.sample_desc: About a hundred well-known titles to try searching, lending and holds. Delete them whenever you like.
start.sample_disabled: Not offered because the catalogue already has records.
start.import: Import from Koha or another system
start.import_desc: After setup you will go straight to the MARC import (MARCXML or ISO 2709, with Koha 952 holdings).

review.title: Check and finish
review.lead: Look over your choices. Nothing has been saved yet.
review.note: Finishing saves everything at once. You can change any of it later under Administration.

done.title: {library} is ready
done.lead_signed_in: You are signed in as the administrator.
done.rules: Lending rules, item types and borrower categories created
done.tip_2fa: Turn on two-step verification for your account (My account & security).
done.tip_staff: Add staff accounts and give them roles under Patrons and Administration → Roles.
done.tip_settings: Set opening hours in the calendar and notice delivery (e-mail, SMS) under Administration.

err.code_format: Enter the 8-character code, for example ABCD-2345.
err.code_wrong: That setup code is not right. Check the server log or run librowise setup-code.
err.code_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
err.username: Use 3-64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
err.email: Enter a valid e-mail address, like name@example.org.
err.password: Choose a password that meets all the requirements below.
err.confirm: The two passwords do not match.
err.branch_code: Use 1-16 capital letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
err.branch_code_dup: Each branch needs a different code.
err.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
err.generic: Setup could not be saved. Please try again.
